name: Binance CEX
notes: Centralized exchange. TVL is reserve wallet balances tracked off-chain by DefiLlama; no protocol contracts and no public subgraph/indexer exist for Binance CEX.

name: OKX
notes: Centralized exchange (reserve wallets). No protocol contracts to index; no public indexer.

name: Bitfinex
notes: Centralized exchange (reserve wallets). No public subgraph/indexer.

name: Lido

repos.scope: Lido stETH/wstETH staking on Ethereum mainnet (Lido.ts mappings, rewards, transfers)
repos.verified: Official lidofinance org repo; contains src/Lido.ts mappings and README documenting The Graph deployment for Lido contracts. Hosted-service era repo, now lower activity but source is public and indexes Lido.

notes: Official subgraph under lidofinance org. Also deployed on The Graph decentralized network (id HXfMc1jPHfFQoccWd7VMv66km75FoxVHDMvsJj5vG5vf).

name: Bybit
notes: Centralized exchange (reserve wallets). No public subgraph/indexer.

name: SSV Network

repos.scope: SSVNetwork smart contract events on Ethereum (validators, clusters, operators)
repos.verified: Official ssvlabs org repo. Contains subgraph.yaml, schema.graphql, abis/SSVNetwork.json. Latest release v2.0.11 (Apr 2026), 223 commits. Indexes SSVNetwork contract events.

notes: Official subgraph indexing the SSVNetwork contract; deployed on The Graph Studio.

name: Aave V3

repos.scope: Aave V3 (and V2) across 20+ networks: ETH mainnet, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Scroll, zkSync, Linea, Sonic, etc.
repos.verified: Official aave org repo. Contains templates/v3.subgraph.template.yaml, schema.graphql, src mappings, abis, multi-network config. 279 commits with recent V3 network additions.

notes: Official Aave protocol subgraphs repo with dedicated V3 templates and active multi-chain V3 deployments.

name: Robinhood
notes: Centralized brokerage/exchange (reserve wallets). Robinhood GitHub orgs host non-indexing repos; no public subgraph/indexer for the protocol TVL.

name: LayerZero V2
notes: Omnichain messaging protocol. LayerZero-Labs publishes protocol/devtools contracts (LayerZero-v2, devtools) but no public subgraph/indexer for endpoint TVL was found; analytics served via the closed LayerZero Scan API. Community Python Scan wrapper exists but is not an indexer of the protocol.

name: WBTC
notes: Custodial wrapped-BTC token (BitGo). Only a community proof-of-concept subgraph exists (ssilvajb/subgraph-wbtc); no official WBTC indexer. WrappedBTC org hosts DAO/website repos only.

name: Morpho Blue

repos.scope: Morpho Blue markets + MetaMorpho vaults (Messari Lending schema), Ethereum mainnet
repos.verified: Official morpho-org repo. Contains subgraph.yaml, schema.graphql, abis, src TS mappings; indexes all Morpho Blue markets with Chainlink price mapping. Archived/read-only as of Apr 2026.

repos.scope: Morpho Blue markets & MetaMorpho vault user positions/points
repos.verified: Official morpho-org repo with releases; tracks user proportions across Morpho Blue markets and vaults.

notes: Official morpho-org subgraphs. The flagship morpho-blue-subgraph was archived Apr 2026; blue-points-subgraph and positions-indexer-subgraph remain available. Docs page (docs.morpho.org/tools/offchain/subgraphs) blocked 403 but repos verified directly.

name: Binance staked ETH
notes: WBETH is a custodial Binance liquid-staking wrapper (contract 0xa2E3356...E2e1). No official or community public subgraph/indexer found; rebasing/value handled off-chain by Binance.

name: Sky Lending

repos.scope: MakerDAO/MCD (now Sky) CDP vaults: Vat.frob LogNote events tracking collateral (ink/dink) and debt (art/dart), DAI
repos.verified: Messari standardized lending subgraph. Contains schema.graphql, src mappings, abis, protocols/makerdao/config; README documents indexing the MCD Vat contract. Sky Lending is the rebrand of MakerDAO MCD, indexed by this subgraph.

notes: No dedicated official Sky/MakerDAO subgraph repo found under sky-ecosystem org (contracts only). Best public indexer is the Messari MakerDAO subgraph covering the same MCD/CDP system. protofire/makerdao-scd-subgraph covers legacy single-collateral DAI (out of scope for current Sky TVL).

name: Hyperliquid Bridge
notes: Canonical USDC deposit bridge for the Hyperliquid L1. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer for the bridge contract; hyperliquid-dex publishes node/SDK and a HyperEVM block indexer example, not a bridge-TVL indexer.

name: Coinbase Bridge
notes: Custodial Coinbase reserve/bridge balances tracked off-chain. No public protocol subgraph/indexer.

name: MEXC
notes: Centralized exchange (reserve wallets). No public subgraph/indexer.

name: EigenCloud

repos.scope: EigenLayer protocol state and rewards: indexes Ethereum blockchain data for staker/operator/AVS rewards and protocol state
repos.verified: Official Layr-Labs repo. Go-based open-source verified indexer (Indexer + State Manager + Rewards Engine + API server). 1,412 commits, latest v4.1.0 (Mar 2026) across mainnet/testnet/preprod.

notes: EigenCloud/EigenLayer (Layr-Labs). Official indexer is the Sidecar (custom Go indexer), not a subgraph. Actively maintained.

name: Ethena USDe
notes: A deployed Ethena subgraph exists on The Graph decentralized network (id E11rAmbGfTfFSjvM6jpCB5TVCL3rBzr84ueShketo294, Arbitrum) and Goldsky has been used for USDe data, but no public source git repo could be verified. ethena-labs org publishes minting SDKs and ethena_sats_adapters (points adapters, RPC-based), not a public TVL subgraph/indexer. Marked false pending a verifiable public repo.

name: USDT0

repos.scope: Cross-chain USDT0 (LayerZero OFT) transfers across HyperSync-supported networks
repos.verified: Envio HyperIndex indexer. Contains config.yaml, schema.graphql, package.json, .env.example; indexes the USDT0 OFT contract for cross-chain transfers. Small repo (4 commits) but functional and on-point.

notes: USDT0 is Everdawn Labs' LayerZero OFT-based omnichain USDT. No official Everdawn repo found; best public indexer is the Envio (enviodev) HyperIndex usdt0-indexer.
